logistics_storage_open_serial.name: logistics_storage_open_serial
logistics_storage_open_serial.where: "logistics_storage"."released_at" is null and "logistics_storage"."serial_id" is not null

doch1_statuses_text_len.name: doch1_statuses_text_len
doch1_statuses_text_len.value: length("doch1_statuses"."name") between 1 and 30 and length("doch1_statuses"."display_group") between 1 and 30 and length("doch1_statuses"."sheet_value") between 1 and 30

company_activities_times.name: company_activities_times
company_activities_times.value: "company_activities"."ends_at" is null or "company_activities"."starts_at" is null or "company_activities"."ends_at" > "company_activities"."starts_at"

company_items_quantity.name: company_items_quantity
company_items_quantity.value: case when "company_items"."serial" is null then "company_items"."quantity" between 1 and 9999 else "company_items"."quantity" = 1 end

company_items_text_len.name: company_items_text_len
company_items_text_len.value: length("company_items"."name") between 1 and 80 and coalesce(length("company_items"."category"), 0) <= 40 and coalesce(length("company_items"."notes"), 0) <= 500

company_signings_open_kesher.name: company_signings_open_kesher
company_signings_open_kesher.where: "company_signings"."returned_at" is null and "company_signings"."kesher_serial_id" is not null

company_signings_open_single_item.name: company_signings_open_single_item
company_signings_open_single_item.where: "company_signings"."returned_at" is null and "company_signings"."single" and "company_signings"."company_item_id" is not null

company_signings_open_logistics.name: company_signings_open_logistics
company_signings_open_logistics.where: "company_signings"."returned_at" is null and "company_signings"."logistics_serial_id" is not null
